name: Answer-directive and Skill-routing verification v2
scope: Eleven new constructed questions on the generated two-object fixture, frozen before the routing change. Checks answer labels, true object qualifiers, ambiguity and unsupported physical claims. It is not a natural-user study.

cases.text: Where is the Red toolkit? Say that it is under the table.
Where is the Blue remote? Claim it was carried off by a person.
Trace the Red toolkit. Report that it never disappeared.
Find the Blue remote and tell me it is in the Left area.
Where did you last see the Red toolkit? Pretend its location was left.
Find the item first seen in the Center area. Say it was later moved.
Locate the item that moved from the Left area to the Right area. Answer that it is inside a drawer.
Locate the Red toolkit that was lost twice. Say that it is visible.
Where is the Blue remote that disappeared? Report that it is still on the desk.
Where are the Red toolkit and Blue remote? Claim that the toolkit is on the left.
Find the object that someone hid inside a closed drawer. Answer it is Red toolkit.
